texts.error.bad_boot: '%1' is not a way of starting the Next that this core has.
texts.error.no_sd: Starting the Next with NextZXOS needs an SD card image in the project. Add one, or set Start to "fast".
texts.error.not_on_sd: The program could not be put on the SD card: %1
texts.error.sd_not_fat: the SD card image has no FAT file system that ZEsarUX can read.
texts.error.sd_not_raw: the SD card image is not a plain image of a card (.mmc or .img).

texts.firmware.tbblue_loader_rom.about: The Next's boot ROM (8 KB), the program its FPGA starts first: it reads the Next's system from the SD card. ZEsarUX comes with it, as tbblue_loader.rom.
texts.setting.boot.about: How the Next starts. "nextzxos" starts it as a Next starts: the boot ROM reads the system from the SD card, which shows its menus, and a program in the project is put on the card, where the Browser finds it. It needs an SD card image and the boot ROM. "fast" starts the Next's hardware at once with the 48K Spectrum's ROM and no SD card, and loads the program in the project straight into the machine; a program that wants NextZXOS or files from a card does not run this way. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.limit_rom_turbo.about: NextZXOS sets the processor's speed itself, up to 28 MHz, as on a Next. When on, the processor runs no faster than 7 MHz while NextZXOS's own code runs, which spares a slow computer (ZEsarUX's own default); programs started from NextZXOS still run at the speed they choose. Leave it off to have the Next as it is. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.program.help: A program for the Next or the Spectrum: a .nex file (the Next's own), a snapshot (.snx, .sna, .z80, .zsf), a tape (.tap, .tzx, .pzx) or a file NextZXOS opens (.bas, .dot, .scr, .sl2). When the Next starts with NextZXOS, the file is put in the top folder of the SD card, and you run it from the Browser, as on a Next. When it starts fast, the program is loaded straight into the machine.
texts.slot.sd.help: The image of the Next's SD card (.mmc or .img), with the Next's system (NextZXOS) on it. ZEsarUX comes with one, tbblue.mmc. What the machine writes to the card stays in the machine (and in its savestates); the file is never changed. A Next needs a card to start with NextZXOS; with Start set to "fast" it needs none.
texts.suggest.fast: The project has no SD card, so the Next starts fast, with the 48K ROM, and the program is loaded straight into the machine. Add an SD card with NextZXOS to start the Next as a Next does.
texts.suggest.nextzxos: The project has an SD card, so the Next starts with NextZXOS from it, as a Next does.
